mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 2.0%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE below 4.5%) signals tightening labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 4.5%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL above 270) indicates persistent price pressures, prompting Federal Reserve rate hikes that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 270.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll growth (PAYEMS above 200,000) signals expanding labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS exceeds 200,000, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based economic strength, driving equity market gains over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint expansion in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to yield positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100) signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings visibility and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 100, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High retail sales (RSAFS above 600,000) indicates strong consumer spending, which directly supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 600,000.
